ratios.facility: Credit agreement (Revolving Loan Facility and Term Loan Facility)
ratios.quote: The credit agreement requires the Company to maintain an interest coverage ratio of not less than 3.00 to 1.00 and a leverage ratio of not more than 3.50 to 1.00 on a rolling four quarter basis.

parsed.notes: The filing does not disclose the actual ratios, only the requirements and a statement that the Company was in compliance as of September 30, 2026. The leverage ratio is classified as net leverage because it is defined as consolidated funded indebtedness less cash and cash equivalents (with the cash deduction capped at $300 million) divided by Adjusted EBITDA. Both ratios are measured on a rolling four-quarter basis. A covenant relief period with modified covenants applied to quarters from June 30, 2025 through June 30, 2026 and ended in Q3 2026; the relief-period limits are not stated. The 6.95% Senior Notes indenture terms are excluded.
